overview.short: Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary, declared a Tiger Reserve in 2012, is located in Jannaram mandal of Mancherial district, Telangana. Spanning over 890 sq km along the Godavari and Kadam river basin, it forms a vital teak forest sanctuary for tigers, leopards, and gaurs.
overview.description: Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary, designated as the Kawal Tiger Reserve, is a pristine wildlife sanctuary situated in Jannaram mandal of Mancherial district in northern Telangana. Nestled in the catchment basin of the Godavari and Kadam rivers, this expansive protected reserve of over 890 square kilometres forms one of the richest dry deciduous teak forest ecosystems in the Deccan Peninsula. Providing a vital habitat and migration corridor for Bengal tigers, leopards, Indian gaurs, nilgai, sambar deer, and over 300 avian species, Kawal offers nature lovers an authentic wilderness experience.

topPlaces.name: Jannaram Forest Gateway & Interpretation Centre
topPlaces.description: The primary tourism gateway into Kawal Tiger Reserve. It houses the wildlife interpretation centre, forest safari boarding point, and Haritha forest resort eco-cottages.

image.alt: Wooden forest walkway and jungle safari entrance at Jannaram

topPlaces.travelTime: ~5 mins walk from Jannaram town center

topPlaces.name: Kadam Dam & Reservoir
topPlaces.distance: 22 km from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary, Telangana
topPlaces.description: Constructed across the Kadam River tributary of Godavari, this picturesque masonry dam is enclosed by verdant forest hills, offering boating, sunset views, and scenic picnic grounds.

image.alt: Vast serene water reservoir and green wooded hills at Kadam Dam

topPlaces.travelTime: ~30 mins drive from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary

topPlaces.name: Godavari River Basin at Mancherial
topPlaces.distance: 45 km from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary, Telangana
topPlaces.description: The life-giving Godavari River flows majestically through the southern border of the sanctuary landscape, nourishing riverine forests and providing scenic rocky sandbars.

image.alt: Broad flowing river waters reflecting golden evening light

topPlaces.travelTime: ~55 mins drive from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary

topPlaces.name: Gandhari Vanam & Nature Park
topPlaces.distance: 38 km from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary, Telangana
topPlaces.description: A sprawling eco-park and deer reserve featuring walking nature trails, medicinal plant enclosures, and the historic remains of the medieval Gandhari Fort atop a nearby hillock.

image.alt: Nature trails and tree canopy in Gandhari Vanam eco-park

topPlaces.travelTime: ~45 mins drive from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary

topPlaces.name: Kuntala Waterfalls (Western Adilabad)
topPlaces.distance: 65 km from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary, Telangana
topPlaces.description: Telangana's highest waterfall, where the Kadam River cascades 147 feet down red sandstone cliffs in two distinct tiers, enclosed by the Sahyadri mountain ranges.

image.alt: Majestic two-tiered waterfall cascading through dense forest cliffs

topPlaces.travelTime: ~1 hr 30 mins drive from Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary
